fit.gap_handling_summary: Core stack matches strongly and is shown clearly; gaps (testing, accessibility, Next.js, Storybook) are simply not claimed, nothing faked. Fintech regulated context could have been framed more explicitly.

issues: No contact details (user chose to leave them out, material has none)
Nordkust Media entry has no years ('Four years before Sjöbris Digital') instead of 2014–2018
No education or languages section (none in material)

ats.reason: Clean, ordered, well-sectioned text with the core stack in searchable terms and nothing unsupported; only minor lost keywords and many ad requirements the material does not cover.

issues: 'without assuming that fintech and health-data requirements are identical' is slightly defensive
No mention of accessibility experience to back the WCAG reference
strengths: Links onboarding conversion work to booking and intake journeys
Uses company principles (privacy by default, WCAG 2.2 AA) accurately

spacing_issues: Bottom fifth of CV page empty
consistency_issues: Cover letter has no header matching the CV
issues: No contact header on either document

fluency_and_tone_issues: 'makes the purpose of this role concrete'
'without assuming that fintech and health-data requirements are identical'

requests.request: Please write my CV first, then the cover letter.
requests.evidence: Both CV and cover letter exist

requests.request: I'd rather leave those details out.

evaluation.summary: A truthful, well-targeted application: every claim traces to the portfolio, notes or earlier letter, with the acting-lead role and tech-lead role worded accurately. The CV is clean and ATS-friendly with the core React/TypeScript/NestJS/PostgreSQL stack prominent. Gaps like testing, accessibility and Next.js are left out rather than faked. Minor weaknesses: Nordkust Media lacks real dates, no contact details (by user choice), and the regulated-fintech angle and GraphQL keyword are underused.
